chapter_seo_title: Li Huowang meets the Superintendent in a chilling, reality-bending illusion
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang finally speaks to the Superintendent of the Heavenly Office—only to discover the entire conversation was an illusion. A chilling chapter on cosmic bureaucracy and hidden power.
og_title: The Deal with the Superintendent: An Illusion of an Alliance
og_description: Li Huowang finally gets his audience with the highest authority—but was any of it real? Chapter 548 is a masterclass in horror through polite, bureaucratic reasonableness.
twitter_title: When a god-like bureaucrat treats your vengeance as a side quest
twitter_description: The Superintendent says yes to killing the Dice—then reveals the whole meeting was an illusion. Cosmic horror with a clerical twist.

lore_anchors.definition: The highest authority of the Supervisory Heavenly Office, whose power includes the ability to fabricate full sensory illusions. His robe is covered in flowing, alien characters.

A supernatural technique that creates fully convincing, interactive environments indistinguishable from reality. The Superintendent uses it to conduct a negotiation without ever physically meeting Li Huowang.
A historical script used exclusively by women in parts of Hunan Province. Li Huowang compares the Superintendent’s robe characters to Nüshu as a reference for how alien and illegible they are.
A secret or dangerous location previously discovered by Li Huowang. The Superintendent orders him to return and extract its secrets as collateral for the alliance.
A sect of liars and tricksters who weaponize falsehood and cognitive manipulation. The Dice is one of its high-ranking members.
